complete_English_exchange.english: You figured it out?

complete_English_exchange.english: Someday, whoever comes to rule each sea is destined to obtain its map. That's what it says.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: Then if we collected them ourselves...!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Julio Erneco
complete_English_exchange.english: Exactly. Then you'd truly be ruler of the world's seas.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: The rumor may be false, but Africa could yield a clue.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: Athens is a city of learning and philosophy!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Janus Pasar
complete_English_exchange.english: This city makes you want to study.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Cesare Tony
complete_English_exchange.english: Exactly. We may learn something too!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Claudio Manaus
complete_English_exchange.english: Why are you always so uptight?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Cristina Erneco
complete_English_exchange.english: Don't be so quick to complain!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: Claudio, you're always complaining.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Claudio Manaus
complete_English_exchange.english: Yeah, yeah. Got it. Enough from me.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: Oh, right... Julio, what was that errand you mentioned?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Julio Erneco
complete_English_exchange.english: I'm going to look into the Proof of Conquest.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: What's this Proof?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Julio Erneco
complete_English_exchange.english: That's what I'm going to find out.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Julio Erneco
complete_English_exchange.english: Just wait a bit. I'll be right back.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: Uh... all right.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: Hm? What's that?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Port Worker
complete_English_exchange.english: What?! No ship would agree to that! Try elsewhere!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: Deck, hold, anywhere is fine. Just take me to some faraway country.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Port Worker
complete_English_exchange.english: At your age, could you even swab the deck?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: Oh, don't say that. Please?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: Excuse me. What's wrong?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: Oh! You're a sailor from the ship that just came in, aren't you? Would you take me aboard?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Port Worker
complete_English_exchange.english: Don't do it, Captain. This old man expects a free ride!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: You want to sail... Should we bring you along?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Claudio Manaus
complete_English_exchange.english: Why take on another old man?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: I suppose that's a no, then...?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: Tell us why you want to go. Then we'll decide.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: I'm Hans Letzel, a naturalist.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: The whole world is my subject! Please, let me see it!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: I see...

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Claudio Manaus
complete_English_exchange.english: Now that's impressive!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: Claudio?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Claudio Manaus
complete_English_exchange.english: At his age, he's braving dangerous seas for his research. Now that's dedication! He has my respect!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: Y-yeah, you're right. Hans, join us.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: You mean it? Thank you!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: Admiral, one more favor, if you please...

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: What is it?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: Could you take one more person aboard?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: My assistant, a promising young... man. Ahem. Arcadius, introduce yourself.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
complete_English_exchange.english: ...I'm Arcadius Eudoxios. It's a pleasure to meet you.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Janus Pasar
complete_English_exchange.english: (Wow... He's awfully slender.)

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Claudio Manaus
complete_English_exchange.english: (You're one to talk. Still, he makes even you look sturdy.)

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: Ahem!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: And it's not just his dedication to learning. He's a promising... young man.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
complete_English_exchange.english: I've studied navigation a little, but I still have a lot to learn from all of you.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: Don't worry about it. We're only getting started ourselves.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
complete_English_exchange.english: That's reassuring.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: Wonderful! All is well. Our grand voyage begins!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Janus Pasar
complete_English_exchange.english: This voyage should be fun.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: It's reassuring to have such a knowledgeable scholar with us, isn't it, Claudio?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Claudio Manaus
complete_English_exchange.english: Yeah, guess so. Keep up the good work, Doctor! ...And you too, Arcadius!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: Leave it to me!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
complete_English_exchange.english: Pleased to join you...

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Julio Erneco
complete_English_exchange.english: Hey!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: Oh, Julio!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Julio Erneco
complete_English_exchange.english: Hm? So this is where you've been!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: Julio! What a surprise!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Julio Erneco
complete_English_exchange.english: Hans! There you are!

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: What?! You were looking for him?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Julio Erneco
complete_English_exchange.english: Yes. He's an acquaintance who's studied the Proof for years.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: Oh! The Proof interests you too?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Rafael Castor
complete_English_exchange.english: Interested? What exactly is the Proof of Conquest, anyway?

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
complete_English_exchange.english: They're treasures scattered across the seas, said to be claimed by those who rule each region.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Hans Letzel
complete_English_exchange.english: Much is still a mystery, but I think we may have a lead on where to find the treasures.

complete_English_exchange.speaker: Julio Erneco
complete_English_exchange.english: You figured it out?
